purpose: Extended deterministic (zero floating-point-noise) correctness verification, added after the crop-bug fix (commit 33e7433) in direct response to user request for more testing before trusting the fix.
added_this_run: Two additional, more extreme draft/target phase gaps (3.14159265 'extreme-opposite-phase', 6.0 'extreme-high-freq-shift') on top of the original 0.6/2.4 gaps -- pushes the reject/resample/rollback path harder.

EOS-mid-chunk truncation-parity test (test_eos_mid_chunk): forces an EOS token to land in the MIDDLE of an accepted gamma=5 block (not at a round boundary) via a logit override (+100/-100), and checks that speculative_generate and speculative_generate_cached truncate at exactly the same point. Mirrors 'pitfall 13' from a peer's independent test suite, which our original 144-case sweep never exercised (no case ever produced an EOS token).

main_sweep.description: 2 temperature modes x 4 phase gaps x 3 seeds x 3 gammas x 4 prompts

eos_mid_chunk.description: 2 temperature modes x 4 phase gaps x 3 seeds, EOS forced at absolute position 5 (offset 2 of a gamma=5 block starting at prompt end, position 3)

interpretation: All 312 cases pass, including the two new extreme phase gaps and the EOS-mid-chunk truncation case. Because this model has zero floating-point noise by construction, this is a proof (not a statistical sample) that the cache/position/truncation bookkeeping in speculative_decode_kv.py is correct under these adversarial conditions, not just the 'normal' conditions the original 144-case sweep covered.
